     Introduced by Hahnemann, proved by himself, Foissac, Röhl, Rummel, Schreter and Nenning (Chronische Krankheiten), by the Austrian provers, Arneth, Boehm, Froelich, Hampe, A. and W. Huber, Reisinger, Reiss, Wachtel, Wagner, Watzke, Weinke, Würstl, Wurmb, Zlatarovich (Oest. Zeit. für Hom., vol. 4), Farrington (Am. J. H. M. M., vol. 4, p. 102), Berridge (N. A. J. Hom., 1871, p. 58, 1873, p. 503) and Robinson (Br. Jour. Hom., vol. 25, p. 325).

     The provings were made with dilutions ranging from the 1st to the 30th.
